provenance: Original synthetic Rosevine task definitions; no copied external tasks.
split_rule: Distinct exact prompts/IDs; shared templates. Holdout must not be used for tolerance or candidate calibration.
scoring: Strict JSON equality of visible response, including integer types; no markdown, duplicate keys or extra keys.
limitations: Shared templates across disjoint prompts; no claim of unseen task-family or pretraining exclusion; not an NLL corpus.
